issues.problem: The title states the studio's own estimate ('well under 0.1%') as flat fact. The script and stat card attribute it correctly to the studio, so this is a wording nit.

issues.quote: Sources: Eurogamer, PC Gamer, VGC, GameSpot and Aftermath.
issues.problem: Aftermath is not among the provided source texts; it is only cited second-hand by the other outlets as the recipient of House House's statement.

check.summary: All factual claims match the sources: the 'well under 0.1%' studio estimate, the roughly 10-line bug fix a Unity engineer could not solve, and Eurogamer's report that 19 IGF jurors will not vote for games using generative AI. The rest is clearly framed opinion. The story is a studio-confirmed disclosure, so not labelling it as rumour is correct. Only minor wording issues.
